title: Coin Change
summary: Use any number of each coin denomination to make exactly the given amount.
statement: Use any number of each coin denomination to make exactly the given amount. Return the fewest coins needed, or −1 if the amount is unreachable.

examples.explanation: Two 3s beat taking 4 followed by two 1s.

hints: Conceptual: Making zero requires no coins.
Directional: If a coin is used last, the remainder must be reachable.
Implementation: Compute the minimum for each amount in increasing order. Initialize positive amounts as unreachable.
complexityAnalysis: O(amount × number of denominations) time and O(amount) extra space.
